title: Shaping integrated policy frameworks for Floating Offshore Wind: Best Practices and Recommendations across Europe
description:
Held on the 18th of March 2025, the webinar gathered experts from the Renewable Energy sector, stimulating the debate about potential socio-economic benefits, environmental impacts and the need for an integrated Maritime Spatial Planning to manage the existing conflicts with other uses of the sea. By promoting the sharing of best practices and different perspectives on the topic, the webinar contributed to trace the pathway towards a sustainable development of Floating Offshore Wind in Europe.
Speakers: Enrico Carloni, Elena Ciappi, Riccardo Coletta, Leonidas Parodos, Cristina Simioli and Rosalie Tukker

title: Unlocking the potential of Floating Offshore Wind: Which opportunities for Europe?
description:
Held on the 19th of May 2025, the webinar addressed the current challenges and barriers hindering the deployment of the full potential of FOW technologies, assessing the existing gaps in terms of skills, infrastructures and manufacturing processes, while discussing the need to take policy measures and to foster the adoption of a pan-European collaborative approach for the successful creation of a European-based value chain.
Inspired by the sharing of best practices stemming from the Med Wind project and the presentation of the techno-economic and financial analysis carried out by the MARINEWIND project, the webinar provided first-hand insights and contributed to pave the way towards more-informed RES policies to support a sustainable development of Floating Offshore Wind in Europe.
Speakers: Tor Arne Johnsen from Norwegian Offshore Wind, Monica Lucarelli and Filippo Barzaghi from Nadara, Paolo Sammartino from Renexia Spa, Inès Tunga from Energy Systems Catapult and Paola Zerilli from University of York
